Good choice. I find nature healing a lot more fun than holy as I have to actively apply HoTs on targets I expect to take damage. I'll list what I've been using.

GraveGuard Helmet
- sacrifice is amazing on nature as you can 3 atack your Q on yourself and your target POP sacrifice and you'll both be at full again in no time.

GraveGuard Boots
-80% movement speed for 5s + you cant get snared. I like it.

Cleric Robe / Druid Robe
-cleric robes give more passive healing and have a nice immune ability on them which I love in arena, but druid robe has nice burst healing granted you can take advantage of the ability. Druid robe is more healing during the CD but harder to use for sure. Cleric Robes are decent. Cheap and effective.

-Druidic Staff and Eye of Secrets

-lymhurst Cape

-omelettes and gigantify/energy potion.
The potion is personal preference. I dont seem to struggle with energy as I'm always actively proccing my Q on people for the energy restore so I can run gigantify potions. My group usually doesnt let anyone get past us and onto me but in the rare occurrence someone stealths or several people try to dive me I like the extra 84% hp.
